d: Pradhanmantri narendr modi ke manila daure ka aaj dusra din hai. is dauran pradhanmantri ne sadi purane gurudvara khalsa divan sahib pahunchkar mattha teka aur desh-duniya men sukh, shanti evan samriddhi ki kamna ki. vahin, aasiyan-bharat shikhar sammelan men bharat ne kshetriy sahyog, shanti aur sthirta ko majbut karne par jor diya. dusri or, jharkhand ke gumla ki nisha bhagat maut mamle men sibiaaee ne janch shuru kar di hai. dilli sthit speshal kraim branch men mamla darj karne ke bad sibiaaee ki tim ne namjad aaropi ajay tirki aur jyotsana kerketta ke aavas par ghanton talashi li aur…
